title: Change words safely
summary: textContent replaces the text inside an element.
introduction: textContent replaces the text inside an element. Your task: Replace Mia with a different name.
learningObjectives: Replace Mia with a different name.
Explain the example for change words safely

blocks.text: textContent replaces the text inside an element. It treats new content as words rather than reading it as HTML markup.
The HTML examples are complete small page parts. Use this site's HTML Run button. Put the script after the elements it uses so those elements already exist.
Read the code step by step

items: `textContent` reads or replaces plain text inside an element. It does not interpret the supplied words as HTML.
`querySelector` finds the first matching element. Check for a missing result when the element is optional.

blocks.text: The paragraph changes from Waiting to Welcome, Mia!.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Use textContent for ordinary user text. Inserting untrusted strings as HTML can make unwanted page parts run.

blocks.title: Your small task
blocks.text: Replace Mia with a different name.
